listing.name: Gran Turismo 4 (PlayStation 2) (GT4Recomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Windows x64 installer; stable v1.2.3. Separate v1.3.0-rc5 test channel has portable ZIP. Limits: Stable1.2.3 playable with known limits;1.3RC channel differs. No full-game completion claim; wheel/license demos limited. Upstream platforms: Windows10/11 x86-64 installer; stable/prerelease package channels distinct. No native Linux/macOS package established. Original data: User-owned USA v2.00 SCUS-97328 ISO; optional Spec II 1.10 owned image only on prerelease. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
